items.html: No kernel mechanics — no new transcript event, no instance state; L0f is pure pre-kernel input preparation → by design
No central store / registry — only a local source; remote sourcing & governance is → L11+
No definition PRs (L12) or trust (L13) — authoring & provenance of templates is later → later
No full schema system — types are a minimal closed set; no constraints, regex, or cross-field validation → later
Global-leniency tradeoff: a typo in a global optional slot may be silently ignored; required slots are still protected by unbound_required_slot, and stricter config linting can come later → later
No per-step / dynamic slot resolution — slots resolve once at start; the per-step config cascade is L0c, conditional/per-step context is → L2b
No actor/model binding as slots — the role → actor and agent/model cascades stay separate; the project is a new tier in them, not a scalar slot → by design
No slot interpolation here — branch_pattern is resolved as a pattern; the actual branch name is materialized provider-side once instance_id exists → L0e
No run-scoped mode / variants — a single template running in code | doc modes is an L0f-family resolution extension, realized as a delta on top of this baseline → L0g (run-scoped mode / variants)
